column1:
Operational risk is defined as the
risk of loss resulting from inadequate
or failed internal processes, people,
systems, or external events.
column3:
A comprehensive operational risk management framework has been deployed
with the following key components:
§ Risk and control self-assessments.
§ Key Risk Indicators.
§ Operational risk incidents management.
